tsa-a21-v01.quick_english: Thus the whole, permanent, occasion-bound rite is established.

tsa-a21-v02.quick_english: Now the authority of this very tradition is stated.

tsa-a21-v03.quick_english: Therein — in the universe made of mere consciousness alone, and in consciousness of vimarśa-nature, and in vimarśa's sound-nature established — of the world-established thing and its manifold act-fruit connections: whatever contemplation that is, that indeed is scripture. Whole scripture-structure, in fact, is one-fruit-attaining, by one-duty-declaration alone; but there, by the Lord's necessity-power-glory, people's establishment is in each part.

tsa-a21-v04.quick_english: Some are established in Veda-tradition-and-rest scriptures, in the self of Māyā-fitting-difference-contemplation; others just that kind by liberation-claim, in Sāṃkhya-Vaiṣṇava-scriptures-and-rest; others in the essence of reflecting separated Śiva-nature, in Śaiva-Siddhānta-and-rest; others in the essence of reflecting all-pervasive Lordhood, in Maṅgala-and-rest scriptures; but some very rare, in the self reflecting the Lord's own nature bound by exhaustive limitation-free-bliss-supreme-truth-made-of-consciousness, in the order of blessed Trika scripture; but some by earlier-earlier-abandonment order or by transcendence — thus in this way one-fruit-attainment from one tradition alone.

tsa-a21-v05.quick_english: In the difference-doctrine too, even of all scriptures, in being one Lord's work, authority stands for now: from being based on authority, partial agreement's not-being-denied, and unstopped operation being equal, mutual contradiction from subject-difference is powerless.

tsa-a21-v06.quick_english: Like the brahma-killing-prohibition, ritual-distinction and ritual-excellence — in its absence somewhere being-unqualified: same, like the ashrama-distinction; and from fruit-excellence, excellence just-there. In Upaniṣad-Bhāgavata, in distinct-authorship even, being-made-by-all-knowers is conceivable here — from conjunction of meaning in what-is-said-and-beyond. In eternality even, scriptures' recognition: for-now necessarily-reached, from being-rooted-in-inference-elimination-perception-and-rest — their authority. 'I see gold [and] silver' — indeed, recognition is scripture, through goldsmith-and-others' recognition. Some with-seen-fruit a desirer enjoys: child's engagement just by recognition, not-by-inference-and-elimination — then, from those two's absence, in youth its presence is powerless. But rooting recognition, he — let him be — for someone, some work: some giving fruits of invisible-impotence-nature-dissolution-solitude, some of equality-with-Siva, some ending-in-oneness — she severally many-kinded: thus in a world filled with many recognitions, whoever to-be, he just such recognition by force indeed assumes, ending-in-the-heart.

tsa-a21-v07.quick_english: Thus for the empty being's surplus verbal-connections — any of their recognition taken as proof — scripture-authority is to be granted; that scripture is to be relied on where excellent fruit is: enough by another.

tsa-a21-v08.quick_english: By consciousness-light-supreme-truth-nature, as indeed shines, touches also, so — discriminating.

tsa-a21-v09.quick_english: Being, take refuge in the scripture — essence-of-all-made-consciousness-reflection-vimarśa, O Unsurpassable-self.

tsa-a21-v10.quick_english: In which firm-establishment-made transaction, that very I am fearless.

tsa-a21-v11.quick_english: Then you will be, according-as establishment-attained, Parama-Siva.

tsa-a21-v12.quick_english: In own-firm-establishment-made transaction, the world is without doubt.

tsa-a21-v01.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v01.question: What has just been concluded?
premises: Thus the whole, permanent, occasion-bound rite is established.
tsa-a21-v01.inference: The nitya-naimittika-karma exposition closes: the whole rite-class is nirūpita.

tsa-a21-v02.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v02.question: What is announced now?
premises: Now the authority of this very tradition is stated.
tsa-a21-v02.inference: The discourse turns from rite to prāmāṇya: āgama's authority takes the floor.

tsa-a21-v03.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v03.question: What makes something scripture?
premises: In the consciousness-made universe, vimarśa's sound-nature established, whatever contemplation of the world-thing and its act-fruit manifoldness that is — that is scripture.
Whole scripture is one-fruit-attaining by one-duty-declaration; yet people's rūḍhi stands part-by-part by the Lord's niyati-śakti.
tsa-a21-v03.inference: Śāstra is defined as vimarśana of the established world: structurally one-fruit, pedagogically part-graded by the Lord's necessity-power.

tsa-a21-v04.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v04.question: Where are the one-fruit attainments seated?
premises: Some in Veda-āgama scripture (Māyā-difference self), others Sāṃkhya-Vaiṣṇava, others Śaiva-Siddhānta, others Maṅgala-āgama, some rare in Trika's reflected Lord-nature, some by earlier-abandonment or transcendence.
All from one āgama alone: ekaphalasiddhi.
tsa-a21-v04.inference: Each school's rūḍhi sits in its own scripture, yet the single fruit issues from one āgama — school plurality does not multiply the fruit.

tsa-a21-v05.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v05.question: Does difference-doctrine cancel scripture's authority?
premises: In bheda-vāda too — all scriptures being one Lord's work — authority stands.
Partial agreement undenied, operation unstopped: mutual bādha from viśaya-bheda is akiṃcitkara.
tsa-a21-v05.inference: Even rival doctrines leave āgama's authority standing: contradiction by subject-difference alone is powerless.

tsa-a21-v06.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v06.question: How is āgama's prasiddhi rooted?
premises: Like brahma-killing-prohibition and ashrama-distinction: excellence follows fruit; in Upaniṣad-Bhāgavata distinct-authorship still conceivable, from meaning in what is said and beyond.
'I see gold, silver' — recognition through goldsmiths IS the āgama; child's engagement by recognition alone, inference-elimination absent in youth.
Rooted in recognition, some give impotence-dissolution-solitude fruits, some Siva-equality, some oneness-ending: whoever comes, force-of-heart recognition assumes it.
tsa-a21-v06.inference: Āgama's authority is prasiddhi-based (gold-silver by goldsmiths, child by seeing): recognition, not inference, roots it; and its fruits range severally to the heart's close.

tsa-a21-v07.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v07.question: What licenses the surplus verbal-connections?
premises: For the empty being's surplus vāc-yukti, any recognition taken as proof grants āgama-prāmāṇya; that āgama is relied on where utkṛṣṭa-phala is: enough by another.
tsa-a21-v07.inference: Surplus speech is licensed by any taken-as-proof recognition; the āgama is adopted where the excellent fruit stands — alam anyena.

tsa-a21-v08.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v08.question: How does the light behave?
premises: By consciousness-light-supreme-truth-nature, as it shines it touches also, so — discriminating.
tsa-a21-v08.inference: The paramārtha-light both manifests and contacts: the vivecana follows the double move.

tsa-a21-v09.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v09.question: Whose refuge is the scripture?
premises: Being, take refuge in the scripture — essence of all-made-consciousness-reflection-vimarśa, O Unsurpassable-self.
tsa-a21-v09.inference: The being is bidden to āśraya the śāstra whose sāra is the all-made vimarśa-nature — addressed to the anuttarātman.

tsa-a21-v10.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v10.question: What does the Prakrit verse declare?
premises: In the firm-establishment-made transaction, that very I am fearless.
tsa-a21-v10.inference: The Prakrit seal: in the vyavahāra of made-firm prasiddhi, the speaker is niṣaṅka.

tsa-a21-v11.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v11.question: What follows in the second Prakrit verse?
premises: Then you will be, according-as establishment-attained, Parama-Siva.
tsa-a21-v11.inference: Prasiddhi-attainment issues in Paramaśiva-tva: the verse promises the state conditionally.

tsa-a21-v12.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v12.question: What is asserted of the world?
premises: In own-firm-establishment-made transaction, the world is without doubt.
tsa-a21-v12.inference: The world's transaction, rooted in nija-ḍṛḍha-prasiddhi, stands niḥśaṅka — doubtless.

tsa-a21-v13.speaker: Teacher (āgama-prāmāṇya)
tsa-a21-v13.question: What does the āhnika close with?
tsa-a21-v13.inference: Closing seal: paramaśivatva achieved once the recognitions are crossed — the prasiddhi-series ends in the Lord.

Scripture is vimarśana of the world-thing in the consciousness-made universe — one-fruit in structure, part-graded in rūḍhi by the Lord's necessity-power.
Schools sit rūḍhi in their own scriptures — Veda, Sāṃkhya-Vaiṣṇava, Śaiva-Siddhānta, Maṅgala, rare Trika, abandonment-order — yet the single fruit issues from one āgama.

Surplus speech is licensed by any taken-as-proof recognition; the āgama is relied on where the excellent fruit is — enough by another.
Light by consciousness-nature shines and touches together — the discrimination follows.

Prakrit seal: in the firm-establishment transaction the speaker is fearless.

In the world's own-firm transaction stands doubtless.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta-śānta of authority established (wonder settling into doctrinal calm)
rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya-śama (wonder at recognition-rooted authority, settling into seal)
rasa.justification: The discourse wonders its own ground — gold seen, child seeing — then seals fearlessly: the relish is authority discovered, not asserted.

sections.SUMMARY: Rite established, the discourse turns: the authority of this very tradition is stated. The authority of this very tradition is announced as the discourse's next subject. Scripture is vimarśana of the world-thing in the consciousness-made universe — one-fruit in structure, part-graded in rūḍhi by the Lord's necessity-power. Schools sit rūḍhi in their own scriptures — Veda, Sāṃkhya-Vaiṣṇava, Śaiva-Siddhānta, Maṅgala, rare Trika, abandonment-order — yet the single fruit issues from one āgama. Even in bheda-vāda the authority stands: mutual contradiction from subject-difference alone is powerless. Āgama's prasiddhi is recognition-rooted — gold seen through goldsmiths, child through seeing — its fruits ranging severally to the heart's close. Surplus speech is licensed by any taken-as-proof recognition; the āgama is relied on where the excellent fruit is — enough by another. Light by consciousness-nature shines and touches together — the discrimination follows. Being, take refuge in the scripture whose sāra is the all-made vimarśa — O Unsurpassable-self. Prakrit seal: in the firm-establishment transaction the speaker is fearless. Then you will be, as establishment is attained, Parama-Siva. In the world's own-firm transaction stands doubtless. Then Parama-Siva, established through crossed recognitions.
sections.FUNCTION: Closes the rite-class, defines scripture as world-vimarśana, maps school rūḍhi to one-fruit, defends authority against bheda-vāda, roots it in recognition, and seals with two Prakrit verses into Parama-Siva.
sections.KEY TERMS: āgama-prāmāṇya (tradition's authority); vimarśa-śabda (scripture as sound-natured contemplation); ekaphalasiddhi (one-fruit attainment); rūḍhi (school establishment); prasiddhi (recognition — goldsmith model); niṣaṅka (fearless — Prakrit seal); paramaśivatva (the closing state).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Follows the nitya-naimittika-karma exposition (u1); the prāmāṇya discourse (u2-9) then the Prakrit/Sanskrit seal (u10-13) close the āhnika.
sections.BOUNDARY: School rūḍhi is described, not adjudicated; the Prakrit verses promise conditionally ('according-as attainment') — no unconditional claim smuggled.
sections.EXPLANATION: Because vimarśa in the consciousness-made universe is what scripture names, authority is prasiddhi-based rather than inferential: the goldsmith sees gold and the child sees by seeing — recognition roots it. Rival bheda-doctrines cannot cancel this, since contradiction by subject-difference alone is powerless. The school plurality is pedagogical (bhāge bhāge rūḍhi), not soteriological: one āgama, one fruit — and the two Prakrit verses carry the attainment from fearless transaction to Parama-Siva.
sections.RELATED: Pradipaka/Tantrāloka parallels on āgama-prāmāṇya (lore support); no external translation witness — qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
